title: Allies Assemble
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng slowly raised his hand, the remnant soul condensing into a complete human form—its face coincidentally overlapping with a vague figure in Chen Ji's memory. This was the truth he had hidden for a full eight years.

text.content: The call echoing from the depths of the turtle shell still reverberated in his ears—that voice belonged to Chen Nian, his sister who had been missing for eight years. Fate played a cruel joke at this moment, forcibly intertwining the answer he had desperately sought with his grand scheme of manipulating the world. Chen Ji stood inside the turtle shell, chaos pervading the surroundings. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm glowed faintly hot, almost too hot to hold. Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from the fragment: 'Boy, are you certain you wish to respond? This might expose all our preparations.'

dialogue.content: What if it gets exposed? Eight years ago, I promised her that no matter what happened, I would find her. This is the only promise I, as her brother, have yet to fulfill.

text.content: Deep within the turtle shell, a sealed altar slowly emerged. At its center, a slender figure was entangled by countless chains—it was Chen Nian. Her eyes were tightly shut, and on her brow center flickered a rune similar to the Tianji Record—a mark of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Su Qingyao's figure stepped out from the shadows, her complexion pale, clearly having rushed here through the night. 'Chen Ji, do you even understand what you're doing? Revealing the aura of the Tianji Record here will make the entire Tianqing Sect aware of your true identity.'

dialogue.content: Did you think I didn't know? Ye Qing's Demonic Path Mist can conceal us for at most an hour. After that hour, experts from the three great sects will all arrive.
Then let them come. I'd like to see who can remain calm when I lay out all my preparations from these years.

text.content: No sooner had the words fallen than a violent tremor came from outside the turtle shell. Ye Qing stepped out from the void, her Demonic Path Mist coiling around the turtle shell like silk threads, completely masking its aura. A hint of astonishment crossed her eyes: 'Chen Ji, have you gone mad? For a single Chen Nian, are you prepared to completely break with our Holy Sect of the Demonic Path?' Chen Ji did not answer. He merely walked slowly toward the altar, each step feeling like treading on the strings of destiny. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, this time carrying an unprecedented gravity:

dialogue.content: Boy, before you touch her, there are some things I must tell you. About your own origins, about the true origin of the Tianji Record, about... why I chose you.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng is finally about to reveal the truth, but Chen Nian's situation is critical. How should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: His sister's safety cannot wait; the truth can be heard later—but this means missing the best opportunity for Mo Xiansheng to proactively reveal his secrets.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance for Mo Xiansheng to reveal his origins
choices.visible_reward: Successfully rescue Chen Nian and temporarily resolve the crisis
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng might withdraw his trust as a result

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm erupted with dazzling light as he pressed his single hand against the rune on Chen Nian's brow center. Heavenly Fate Value flowed away like a tide. The chains began to shatter, and Chen Nian's eyes trembled slightly. Yet just at this moment, Mo Xiansheng's voice turned ice-cold: 'What a fine choice to save your sister first. Since that's how it is, I have nothing more to say—my identity, you'll have to investigate it yourself.'

choices.text: First Listen to Mo Xiansheng's Revelation
choices.description: Since Mo Xiansheng is speaking on his own initiative, it must be crucial information—but with every moment Chen Nian remains trapped, the danger increases.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian Cannot Be Rescued for the Time Being
choices.visible_reward: Gain Important Truths About the Tianji Record and One's Own Origins
choices.risk_hint: May Anger Ye Qing and Su Qingyao

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand reaching toward Chen Nian and turned to face the Tianji Record Fragment. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly condensed, appearing before him for the first time in complete form—a weathered yet still sharp old man's face, surprisingly seven-tenths similar to a vague ancestor figure in Chen Ji's memory. 'Eight years ago, I chose you because you carry the bloodline of the Chen family's direct descendants—and the Chen family was precisely the descendants of the previous generation's Tianji Record inheritor.'

choices.description: Have Ye Qing first use Demonic Path Mist to stabilize Chen Nian's condition while simultaneously listening to Mo Xiansheng—but this will drain Ye Qing's energy significantly.
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing's Condition Declines, Possibly Affecting Subsequent Battle
choices.visible_reward: Both rescuing Chen Nian and obtaining Mo Xiansheng's secret
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may become resentful because of this

text.content: Ye Qing let out a cold laugh: "Chen Ji, you really know how to calculate." But she still raised her hand, and dense Demonic Path fog wrapped around Chen Nian, temporarily stabilizing the erosion from the chains. Mo Xiansheng watched this scene, a trace of appreciation flickering in his eyes: "Good, very good. You understand how to utilize resources around you better than Chen Xuan did back then." He took a deep breath and continued: "Since it's like this, I'll tell you everything—actually, I'm not just the guardian of the Tianji Record, I am also..."

Just as Mo Xiansheng was about to reveal that shocking secret, a thunderous roar echoed from outside the turtle shell—it was the battle cry of Han Lie, the first genius of Xuanwu Sect. Su Qingyao's face changed drastically: "No good, they've found us! Han Lie brought at least thirty elite disciples and surrounded the entire turtle shell area!" Ye Qing furrowed her brow: "The Demonic Path fog can last at most another half hour, Chen Ji, how many trump cards do you still have?" Chen Ji didn't answer, his gaze passing over everyone, landing on Chen Nian on the altar, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips

dialogue.content: Trump cards? I never rely on trump cards. I only rely on—calculation. Do you think I randomly chose this location for our gathering?

text.content: Before his words even finished, countless beams of light blazed from the depths of the turtle shell—those were the lights of formations being activated. Su Qingyao suddenly realized something, her expression becoming extremely complex: "These formations... are they my Tianqing Sect's Mountain Protection Formation?! When did you relocate them here?" Chen Ji said calmly: "Three years ago, when I was sweeping the sect as a worthless servant disciple. Did you really think I was just idling away my time?" Mo Xiansheng let out a low laugh: "Good lad, so from the very beginning you've been setting up this move."

dialogue.content: So those "anomalies" you asked me to investigate were actually clues you deliberately left for me? Chen Ji, were you scheming against me from the start?

Scheming? No, that was called trust. I left those clues for you because I knew that with your intelligence, you would definitely follow the trail. And the deeper you investigated, the more you would stand on my side.

text.content: Su Qingyao stood frozen in place, her heart filled with mixed emotions. She had always thought she was investigating Chen Ji, never expecting that she had long been a piece in his chess game—but this piece had been given the utmost respect. Ye Qing suddenly let out a light laugh: "Interesting, Chen Ji. I finally understand why the Holy Sect fears you so much." Outside the turtle shell, Han Lie's furious roar rang out again: "Chen Ji! You waste hiding inside, get out here! Today I'll teach you what absolute power crushing feels like!"

dialogue.content: "Absolute power crushing? Han Lie, you really never learn. Last time in the secret realm, who was the one I trapped in a third-level formation for three days and three nights?"

choice.prompt: Han Lie brought heavy troops to encircle the turtle shell—this is the critical moment for direct confrontation, and Chen Ji needs to make a decision.

choices.description: Activate the Mountain Protection Formation, cooperate with Ye Qing's Demonic Path fog, and decisive battle with Han Lie inside the turtle shell—high risk, but can completely crush Han Lie's arrogance.
choices.visible_cost: The Mountain Protection Formation will be exposed, and Tianqing Sect will learn of Chen Ji's layout
choices.visible_reward: Thoroughly defeat Han Lie and shock the Three Great Sects

text.content: Chen Ji flicked his hand, and the Mountain Protection Formation roared to life. Countless pillars of light shot up from around the turtle shell, trapping Han Lie and his thirty disciples entirely within the formation. Han Lie's face contorted in shock: "Th-this formation?! Impossible! I'm Xuanwu Sect's first genius! How could a waste like you trap me!" Chen Ji's voice drifted out from within the formation: "Waste? Han Lie, your misunderstanding of me is far greater than your confidence in your own strength."

choices.description: Use the formation for defense, drag it out until Ling Yuan and other hidden allies arrive—more prudent, but Han Lie may break through early.
choices.visible_reward: All secretly positioned allies reveal themselves at once, the lineup is shocking

text.content: Chen Ji paid no attention to Han Lie's taunting, and instead turned to Ye Qing: "How long can your fog last?" Ye Qing said solemnly: "At most one hour." Chen Ji nodded: "That's enough." He turned and walked toward the altar, continuing to unlock the chains on Chen Nian. Just then, an aged yet commanding voice came from outside the turtle shell: "Chen Ji, why resist desperately? Come out. I can give you a dignified ending." It was Ling Yuan—the former sect master of Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji's nominal protector.

choices.description: Reveal Ling Yuan's true identity and conspiracy before everyone—the most shocking, but will completely intensify the conflict.
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao might not be able to accept
choices.visible_reward: Completely break through Ling Yuan's disguise, shocking everyone present

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, and that smile sent a chill through both Su Qingyao and Ye Qing. He slowly stepped out of the turtle shell, facing Ling Yuan, and declared in a loud voice: "Sect Master Ling, you've arrived at just the right moment. I have a grand gift for you—evidence of how you secretly harmed Chen Xuan back then, and how you framed someone else. Would you like to see it publicly?" Ling Yuan's expression instantly darkened, while Su Qingyao's eyes widened in disbelief. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind: "Good lad, this move of cutting off the support is brilliantly executed."

A flash of killing intent crossed Ling Yuan's eyes, but it was quickly masked by a benevolent smile: "Chen Ji, what nonsense are you spouting? I know you have grievances toward the sect, but you shouldn't slander this old man." Chen Ji shook his head, took out a jade slip from his chest, and gently pinched it. Countless images projected from it—scenes of when Chen Xuan was harmed, Ling Yuan's figure clearly visible. Han Lie's expression became extremely interesting; although he was Ling Yuan's ally, he had never imagined this old sect master had such dark secrets.

dialogue.content: Sect Master Ling, you called me waste, yet this waste holds in his hands something that could destroy your reputation entirely. Tell me, isn't this the ultimate irony of fate?

text.content: At this moment, Chen Nian's eyes suddenly opened on the platform. Her gaze pierced through the layers of mist, fixing directly on Chen Ji. Her lips trembled slightly: "Brother... I knew... you'd come..." Chen Ji's heart clenched violently. Eight years of separation, eight years of searching, eight years of scheming—everything was repaid in this moment. He strode quickly toward Chen Nian, but stopped three feet away—because he saw the Heavenly Fate Lock Key rune at Chen Nian's brow center flickering frantically, a terrifying power surging from within her. Mo Xiansheng's voice turned urgent: "Not good! The Heavenly Fate Lock Key has been activated! Chen Ji, you must make a choice—"

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Fate Lock Key in Chen Nian's body has been activated, this is a critical moment threatening her life.

choices.text: Suppress the Lock Key with the Tianji Record
choices.description: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value, use the power of the Tianji Record to forcibly suppress the Lock Key within Chen Nian's body—the cost is enormous, but it can save his sister.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value drops significantly (-30 points), which may affect future foresight ability
choices.visible_reward: Successfully suppress the Lock Key, Chen Nian is temporarily out of danger
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng warns this will expose the complete aura of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji pressed the Tianji Record Fragment against Chen Nian's brow center without hesitation. Heavenly Fate Value gushed out like a breached dam. The rune at Chen Nian's brow center gradually dimmed, while Chen Ji's complexion turned pale at a visible rate. Tears overflowed from Chen Nian's eyes: "Brother, don't... don't sacrifice yourself for me anymore..." Chen Ji forced out a smile: "Silly girl, you're my sister." Mo Xiansheng let out a sigh: "Love... such foolish love..."

choices.text: Let Chen Nian actively control the Lock Key
choices.description: Guide Chen Nian to use her special connection with the Heavenly Fate Lock Key to actively control this power—extremely high risk, but may yield unexpected gains.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian may awaken special abilities, becoming key to countering the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji grabbed Chen Nian's hand, channeling his Tianji Record aura into her body: "Little Nian, listen to me, you're not a vessel for the Lock Key, you're its master. Control it, don't let it control you." Tears streamed down Chen Nian's face, but she nodded. A strange light erupted from her brow center, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key's runes began operating in a completely new way—it no longer corroded Chen Nian, but instead submitted. Ye Qing's eyes widened: "This... how is this possible?" Mo Xiansheng let out an exclamation: "So that's how it is! Chen family's bloodline is the true master of the Lock Key!"

choices.description: Compromise with Ling Yuan, trade the secret of the Tianji Record for his help with Chen Nian—the most humiliating, but can save Chen Nian's life.
choices.visible_cost: May expose the weakness of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might take the opportunity to seize the Tianji Record

text.content: "Chen Ji gritted his teeth, about to speak, when Ling Yuan laughed first: 'Chen Ji, you want me to save your sister? Fine, hand over the Tianji Record, and I won't hold it against you.' Chen Ji's fists tightened, his fingernails digging deep into his palms. Eight years—he had never been so humiliated—but for his sister, he was willing. Just then, Chen Nian's voice rang in his mind, a heart connected by blood: 'Brother, don't. I'd rather die than watch you bow to him.'

Chen Nian's words struck like a heavy hammer on Chen Ji's heart. Looking at his sister's firm eyes, he suddenly smiled—a relieved smile, a smile of finally finding a fellow traveler. 'Good.' He said softly, 'Since it's like this, we'll face all of this together.' He turned to face Ling Yuan, Han Lie, and all the envious enemies, his eyes' temperature dropping to freezing point in an instant: 'You want the Tianji Record? Come then. Let's see who has the ability to take it from me.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji... do you know what you're doing? Sect Master Ling is an establishment from the Yuan Ying stage, and Han Lie is at the Golden Core peak—you, a Foundation Building trash...
Trash? Su Qingyao, you've followed me for so long, can't you see? The so-called trash persona was just a smokescreen I put up for all of you.

text.content: The moment his voice fell, Chen Ji's aura surged violently. The Foundation Building disguise peeled away like shattered masks, revealing the unfathomable true cultivation beneath—it was赫然是golden core后期! Han Lie's face changed drastically: 'Th-this is impossible! You're clearly just a servant disciple! How could your cultivation...' Ling Yuan's eyes flickered with gravity: 'So that's how it is. I was fooled by you for eight whole years.' Ye Qing laughed lightly: 'Interesting. You hid so deeply.' Su Qingyao looked at Chen Ji with complicated eyes, harboring both the fury of being deceived and a kind of 'as expected' relief. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind: 'Boy, it's time to let them see the real Chen family heir.'

dialogue.content: Since there's no point hiding anymore, there's no need for this old man to keep pretending either. Chen Ji, let these people see what a true Tianji Record inheritor looks like!

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul burst forth from the fragment, no longer a虚幻光影, but a condensed humanoid form. His face was aged yet commanding, the aura emanating from him actually not inferior to Ling Yuan's—that was the pressure of the Hua Shen stage! Han Lie's face completely changed: 'Hua Shen stage?! How is this possible!' Ling Yuan's eyes flickered with a trace of fear: 'Chen Xuan... you're actually still alive!' Mo Xiansheng said calmly: 'This old man is merely a remnant soul body, I can't hold on long. But it's enough to tell you one thing—Chen Ji is an inheriter personally chosen by this old man. If any of you dare touch him, even if this old man scatters to nothing, I'll drag you all down with me.'

Chen Nian slowly stood up, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key rune between her brows had completely subsided, replaced by a淡金色光芒—that was the mark of Chen family bloodline awakening. She walked to Chen Ji's side and said softly: 'Brother, I won't hold you back anymore.' Chen Ji reached out and rubbed her hair, his smile warm: 'You never were.' He looked around at Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Mo Xiansheng, and the 'reinforcements' from Ling Yuan that had just arrived—those were actually his secretly placed chess pieces. At this moment, Chen Ji's faction was revealed under the sun for the first time, causing all enemies to feel a bone-deep chill.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, is this all your cards? Demonic Path mist, mountain-protecting formation, Hua Shen stage remnant soul... Honestly, stronger than I imagined.
These are just the appetizers. Ye Qing, are you willing to sign a formal alliance with me? Not an exchange of interests, but true side-by-side combat.

text.content: Ye Qing was stunned for a moment. She looked into Chen Ji's eyes—inside was no scheming, no probing, only pure sincerity. This was the first time in this cultivation world where betrayal and exploitation were the norm that she saw such unconditional trust. Her eyes slightly reddened, but quickly restored her usual coldness: 'Don't you dare regret this.' She extended her hand, and a wisp of Demonic Path mist condensed into the雏形 of a contract in her palm. Chen Ji unhesitatingly injected his Heavenly Fate aura into it, a dual contract forming between them—this was a vow made with their lives, any betrayal from either side would result in Heavenly Dao backlash. Su Qingyao watched this scene and suddenly said: 'Chen Ji, I owe you an apology.'

dialogue.content: I always thought you were using me, treating me as a chess piece. But now I understand... you were protecting me, just like you protected Chen Nian. You were afraid I'd get too deep, so you kept dangling those ambiguous clues, actually giving me a way out.
Su Qingyao, you're the only person who makes me believe there's still someone in this world worth trusting. I don't want to use you, I just... don't know how to say it.

text.content: Outside the Turtle Shell, Ling Yuan's expression was gloomy as water. He originally thought today he could capture Chen Ji in one stroke, never expecting the other had arranged everything long ago. What unsettled him more was Mo Xiansheng's existence—that Chen Xuan who had been framed by him back then, actually survived as a remnant soul. 'Retreat!' Ling Yuan grit his teeth and ordered, 'Today's matter, this old man remembers. Chen Ji, you wait for this old man!' Han Lie wanted to say something, but Ling Yuan slapped him on the back of his neck, knocking him unconscious. Chen Ji watched their retreating backs, his lips curved into a淡笑: 'Sect Master Ling, take your time leaving. The next time we meet, I'll prepare an even bigger surprise for you.'

Inside the Turtle Shell, the tense atmosphere finally eased. Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist slowly dissipated, revealing the empty scene outside. Su Qingyao leaned against the wall, her chest heaving violently, clearly exhausted. Chen Nian nestled by Chen Ji's side, her face carrying the relief of surviving a disaster. Mo Xiansheng transformed into a remnant soul again, shrinking back into the Tianji Record Fragment, but his voice remained clear: 'Boy, you won this round, but the real decisive battle is still ahead. Ling Yuan won't let this rest, and the Heavenly Dao's Eye... has already noticed you.'

dialogue.content: Let it notice. From the day I obtained the Tianji Record, I never thought about hiding. A chess game of fate? Fine, then let me be the chess player.

text.content: Night wind blew through the cracks of the Turtle Shell, carrying a trace of coolness. Chen Ji looked around at the faction he had built with his own hands—Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, was looking at him with complex eyes; Ye Qing, the Demonic Path Saint, had just signed a life-or-death contract with him; Chen Nian, his blood-related kin, had finally returned to his side; Mo Xiansheng, the mysterious master, had finally revealed his true strength. At this moment, he suddenly felt an unprecedented sense of fullness. Not because of power's increase, not because of schemes' success, but because—he was no longer alone.

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, this time with a rare gentleness: 'Chen Ji, you did well. But this old man has one last thing to tell you—about this old man's true identity, about the Tianji Record's true origin, about the... Heavenly Dao's Eye behind all of this.' His remnant soul manifested again, that aged face especially grave under the moonlight: 'Are you ready to listen? This might completely change your understanding of this world.' Chen Ji took a deep breath and nodded. Chen Nian held his hand, Su Qingyao and Ye Qing gathered around as well. Everyone was waiting for that truth about to be revealed.
